AC and DC may also be mixed (p62).","kind":"orderable"},"base":{"default":true,"description":"The chassis as the SR-e guide draws it - both control pairs, every IOM-e, a ME10-10GB-SFP+ in every MDA-e slot, six -48/-60 VDC supplies and two PSU impedance panels, and the fan tray.","kind":"base"}},"description":"The 10RU Nokia 7750 SR-2e service router (800 Gb/s half-duplex, 2 forwarding complexes), one of the three 7750 SR-e chassis that share a midplane design, cards and power supplies. Front: a horizontal card cage at the left under the PSU-shelf air intake - two CCM-e slots (A, B) then 8 MDA-e slots numbered 1/1 to 2/4 - with the integrated cable-management tray beside it and the hinged grill over the air filter at the right. Rear: the PSU shelf across the top (8 slots), the CPM-e slots A and B and 2 IOM-e slots at the left, and the chassis-specific fan tray standing in the vertical slot at the right. Every card lies horizontally, as the guide draws it, so no card bay rotates; the six vertical PSU slots seat the horizontally authored supplies at rotate 90.","format":1,"gaps":[{"note":"Every figure used is vendor line art. Slot boundaries were read where one card's bottom edge meets the next card's top edge along x 200; they fall at a mean pitch of 35.37 mm, and the stack is laid out at the family's U = 35.4 (the conventions' pitch, measured 35.43 across the SR-3e's 14 slots) from y 68.5, which leaves every boundary within 0.4 mm of the drawing. Top to bottom: CCM A, CCM B, then MDA 1/1 onward."},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"SR-e guide Table 22 (p79): 17.5 x 17.5 x 21.2 in (H x W x D), 10 RU; weight 32.4 kg unpopulated, 68.4 kg full. The table's note 2 says the 17.5 in width \"includes the integrated flanges\", but p89 Figure 25 dimensions it otherwise: \"Chassis Width 17.5 in (444.5 mm)\" between arrows that land on the body, and \"Chassis Flange Width 19 in (482.6 mm)\" over the ears, with hole centres 465 mm apart. Measured on that figure at 1200 dpi (9.948 px/mm from the 19 in flange), the body arrows sit 18.4 mm and 20.0 mm in from the flange edges. So the face is the 444.5 between the folds, the ears (about 19 mm a side, not drawn) carry the rack holes, and the note is read as loose wording. Depth 538.5 excludes panel protrusions (note 3)."},"colour":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"No photograph is staged; the charcoal chassis and grey trim are assumed. Those contracts are built on the sibling wave-1 branches (SR-e modules; MDA-e SFP; MDA-e 100G), so on this branch alone they do not resolve; they were checked against those branches' contracts before commit. The 8-port 10/25GE MDA-e (3HE14888AA) is held out of wave 1 (no genuine faceplate drawing) and is not listed."},"defaults":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"As the figures draw the chassis: both CCM-e and both CPM-e, every IOM-e, a ME10-10GB-SFP+ in every MDA-e slot (the front figure's card, legible on every row), DC supplies in PSU 1-6 and PSU impedance panels in PSU 7-8 (key 5), and the chassis's own fan tray."},"esd":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Front ESD jack (key 4 on the front figure): measured at x 449-452 in the face frame, ON THE RIGHT FLANGE outside the 444.5 body (p89 Figure 25 puts it 12.5 mm in from the flange edge, where the body starts about 20 mm in), so it is not drawn - ears are not modelled. Rear ESD jack (the last rear key) is on the plate under the last IOM-e at (269.4, 425.05), drawn with common/esd-jack@1."},"fan-tray":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"The fan tray bay is the tray's stated face, 137.2 x 381, centred on the drawn tray (x 301.5-440.1, y 57.8-440.4) at x 302.2, y 58.3. Drawn as panel decor (a stud plate is chassis metalwork with no part number; no library part draws a two-stud earth point without its own symbol)."},"intake-door":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"The hinged grill (key 6) frame x 301.6-437.7, y 71.9-426.1; opening y 83.4-414.6; louvres at y 102.1, 137.6, 173.2, 208.7, 244.2, 279.7, 315.2, 350.8, 386.3; handle (key 7) at y 228. p69 says the filter slot is \"angled slightly from left to right\"; the door is drawn flat, as the conventions ask (it carries no ports). The hinge brackets and two double-line runs that cross the PSU intake from the top edge (one ends at the handle) straddle the flange fold or are unidentified, and are not drawn."},"other-faces":{"confidence":"estimated","note":"Sides from isometrics only (p116 Figure 28 left, p147 Figure 44 right): LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR, RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT. Figures 8 (p47, front): the whole front over the flanges measures 4135-4150 px across at 1200 dpi and 3814 px top to bottom; 8.587 px/mm across (to 482.6) and 8.580 down (to 444.5) - orthographic to 0.1 percent. The face frame used for every x below is the body centred on the flanges (face x = (px - centre)/8.587 + 222.25), y from the top outer edge. Positions were read by pixel scans along rows and columns of the render and on a millimetre grid laid over it; they are good to about 0.5 mm, the figures' own stroke widths."},"power":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"SR-e guide p82 Table 25: worst-case total power 2762 W (9424.22 BTU/hr), \"with worst-case total power including optical components\"; worst case is 100 percent line rate at 55 C (p83). A bay size is the on-panel footprint and the renderer hangs the occupant at the bay centre, so the bay is NOT given the unrotated 86.4 x 40.4 size the conventions describe. PSU 7-8 are 86.4 x 40.4 at rotate 0 above the fan tray. The PSU n labels sit in cells under the vertical slots; PSU 7 and PSU 8 are printed in two small boxes under PSU 7, with the touch-current warning label below them."},"rear-cage":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"Rear cage: the CPM-e and IOM-e plates measure 43.7-300.0 across (256.3 drawn against the stated 259.1), so the 259.1 bays are centred on them at x 42.3.
